noncomputable def VTask.comk {α : Type*} (p : Set α → Prop) (he : p ∅) (hmono : ∀ (t : Set α), p t → ∀ s ⊆ t, p s) (hunion : ∀ (s : Set α), p s → ∀ (t : Set α), p t → p (s ∪ t)) : Filter α :=
  { sets := {s : Set α | p sᶜ},
    mem_def := by simp [Set.ext_iff],
    nonempty := by
      -- Show that the filter is nonempty by proving that `univ` is in it.
      have h : p (∅ : Set α) := he
      have h₁ : p (univᶜ : Set α) := by
        have h₂ : (univ : Set α)ᶜ = (∅ : Set α) := by simp
        rw [h₂]
        exact he
      exact ⟨univ, by
        have h₃ : (univ : Set α)ᶜ = (∅ : Set α) := by simp
        have h₄ : p (∅ : Set α) := he
        have h₅ : p (univᶜ : Set α) := by
          rw [h₃]
          exact he
        simpa [h₃] using h₅⟩,
    -- Prove that the filter is upward closed.
    upward_closed := by
      intro s hs t ht
      have h₁ : p sᶜ := hs
      have h₂ : s ⊆ t := ht
      have h₃ : tᶜ ⊆ sᶜ := by
        intro x hx
        have h₄ : x ∉ t := hx
        have h₅ : x ∉ s := by
          intro h₆
          have h₇ : x ∈ t := h₂ h₆
          contradiction
        exact h₅
      have h₄ : p tᶜ := hmono sᶜ h₁ tᶜ h₃
      exact h₄,
    -- Prove that the filter is closed under binary intersections.
    binary_inter : ∀ {s t : Set α}, s ∈ this → t ∈ this → s ∩ t ∈ this := by
      intro s t hs ht
      have h₁ : p sᶜ := hs
      have h₂ : p tᶜ := ht
      have h₃ : p (sᶜ ∪ tᶜ) := hunion sᶜ h₁ tᶜ h₂
      have h₄ : (s ∩ t)ᶜ = sᶜ ∪ tᶜ := by
        ext x
        simp [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_inter_iff]
        <;> tauto
      have h₅ : p (s ∩ t)ᶜ := by
        rw [h₄]
        exact h₃
      exact h₅ }
